test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate meaning of the word ‘pervading’ as used in the passage.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'spreading'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word ‘pervading’ is used in the context of mist that fills and spreads into the building.
 
• 'Pervading mist' indicates the mist's presence everywhere, diffusing through the open doors
